summary: NewHold Investment Corp. III, a Nasdaq-listed Cayman SPAC, held an extraordinary general meeting on September 17, 2026, and shareholders approved the business combination with newcleo plc, a UK nuclear technology company, under a May 26, 2026 agreement. At the August 7, 2026 record date, 27,612,763 ordinary shares were entitled to vote and 21,272,849 (77.04%) were represented, with the Business Combination Proposal passing by ordinary resolution. The structure uses two Cayman merger subsidiaries, with NewHold surviving the first merger as a newcleo subsidiary and then merging into Merger Sub 2. Watch redemption levels, closing conditions and Nasdaq listing of the combined entity.
